svg.title: Nuclear power plant
svg.desc: Schematic of a pressurized water reactor power plant. Inside the containment structure, the core in the pressure vessel, with its control rods, heats water that is pumped in a closed loop through the steam generator. Steam from the generator goes along the steam line to the high- and low-pressure turbines, which turn the turbine generator. The spent steam is condensed by cooling water that circulates to the cooling tower, and the condensed water is pumped back to the steam generator.
